milestones.title: Born in Paris
milestones.text: Founded by master perfumer Élise Moreau in a modest Grasse atelier, Étoile began as a personal vision: to craft timeless scents that transcend fashion and trend.

milestones.title: The First Collection
milestones.text: L'Étoile Originelle launched exclusively at Printemps, Paris. Selling out within six weeks, it established Étoile as the avant-garde voice of niche French perfumery.

milestones.title: Global Expansion
milestones.text: Étoile opened its first international boutique in Tokyo's Aoyama district, followed swiftly by New York and Dubai — bringing French olfactory artistry to the world.

milestones.title: The Exclusive Line
milestones.text: Introduction of the ultra-prestige 'Exclusive' tier — higher-concentration formulations using the rarest raw materials sourced from six continents.

milestones.title: Étoile Maison
milestones.text: The opening of Maison Étoile in the 8ème arrondissement — a fully immersive bespoke fragrance salon, combining artistry, craftsmanship, and the ultimate luxury experience.

values.title: Raw Material Purity
values.text: Every ingredient is sourced in partnership with sustainable cooperatives — no synthetics, no shortcuts. We trace every drop from field to flacon.

values.title: Slow Perfumery
values.text: We believe great fragrance cannot be rushed. Each Étoile scent undergoes a minimum 24-month development cycle of evolution, testing, and refinement.

values.title: Responsible Luxury
values.text: Every Étoile flacon uses recycled glass and biodegradable packaging. Our production is carbon-neutral since 2021 — because true luxury respects the earth.

values.title: Personal Connection
values.text: Each fragrance is a conversation between the perfumer and the wearer. We design not for masses but for those who understand the art of wearing an invisible signature.
